text: Tianjin Ground, Air China 410, Stand 203, Information Juliet. Request ATC clearance. Air China 410, cleared to Shanghai. Flight planned route, follow ANRAT 2 Delta Departure. Initial climb to 1,200 metres. After departure, contact 127.9er, squawk 5345. What is the SID, or SID, and transponder code? The SID, or SID, or SID, or SID, or SID, or SID.
